card.name: Falls, impacts and physical damage events
card.fires_on: Verbs and linking words describing something falling, landing, colliding or damaging, in accident, earthquake or storm accounts. It fires on words like landed, fell, falling, collided with, damaged.

modes.label: Falling or landing
modes.description: Words for a person or object falling or landing on something.
modes.example: He stumbled, fell and<< landed>> on a knife.

modes.label: Disaster damage
modes.description: Words for objects shaken loose or destroyed in earthquakes and storms.
modes.example: An earthquake shook objects from<< shelves>> in southeastern Alaska

modes.label: Collision or contact
modes.description: Words right after a collision or contact event, often a small linking word.

card.writes: It seems to push toward verbs of physical harm or impact, mostly in Chinese-character tokens, and away from words of attitude or excess.
